```python
from fractions import Fraction

# Individually label the nine physical balls for exhaustive enumeration.
balls = [
    ("R", 1), ("R", 1),
    ("R", 2), ("R", 2), ("R", 2), ("R", 2),
    ("B", 1),
    ("B", 2), ("B", 2),
]

# (1) All 81 ordered draws with replacement are equally likely.
favorable = sum(
    (balls[i][0] != balls[j][0])
    and (balls[i][1] + balls[j][1] == 3)
    for i in range(9)
    for j in range(9)
)
p1 = Fraction(favorable, 81)
claimed_p1 = Fraction(8, 81)

print("(1) Favorable ordered outcomes:", favorable, "of 81")
print("(1) Exact probability:", p1)
print("(1) Submitted probability:", claimed_p1)
print("(1) CHECK PASS" if p1 == claimed_p1 else "(1) CHECK FAIL")

# (2) All 72 ordered draws of distinct balls are equally likely.
pairs = [(i, j) for i in range(9) for j in range(9) if i != j]
count_a = sum(balls[i][0] == "R" for i, j in pairs)
count_b = sum(balls[j][1] == 1 for i, j in pairs)
count_ab = sum(
    balls[i][0] == "R" and balls[j][1] == 1
    for i, j in pairs
)

pa = Fraction(count_a, len(pairs))
pb = Fraction(count_b, len(pairs))
pab = Fraction(count_ab, len(pairs))
independent = pab == pa * pb

print("(2) P(A):", pa)
print("(2) P(B):", pb)
print("(2) P(A and B):", pab)
print("(2) P(A) * P(B):", pa * pb)
print("(2) Independent:", independent)

part2_ok = pa == Fraction(2, 3) and pb == Fraction(1, 3) and independent
print("(2) CHECK PASS" if part2_ok else "(2) CHECK FAIL")
print("CHECK PASS" if p1 == claimed_p1 and part2_ok else "CHECK FAIL")
```
